question: Is the King Maker enterprise authority site (one-time ~$5k own-it + ~$500/mo efficient off-page ops) a defensibly superior value proposition vs a $297/mo GoHighLevel template, for an NC roofing contractor — and what is the honest, fully-cited case for each claim?
lens: Defensible, not optimistic. Every load-bearing claim cited + adversarially verified; modeled flagged as modeled; ranges not point-promises; explicitly mark what NOT to oversell. The deliverable's credibility IS the product (FTC/screenshot-proof posture).
stopCondition: Each load-bearing claim (the ones that go on a sales slide / reel) has either (a) >=2 independent sources with at least one primary/non-incentivized, OR (b) is explicitly downgraded to modeled/directional/provisional with that flag carried into the claim library. Diverse source lenses exercised (Google first-party, independent SEO studies, contractor-vertical practitioner, platform feature-boards, ROI/economics).
subQuestions: P1 Deep-vs-thin: does ~130 pages out-traffic/out-lead ~15-20 by a defensible multiple, and what gates it (quality, info-gain, site-wide drag)?
P2 Location/service matrix: lift vs one hub; organic ranking in non-located suburbs vs the map-pack proximity ceiling; real-job/unique requirement + doorway downside.
P3 Storm/insurance vertical: post-storm surge %, ticket size, close rate, share of roofer revenue; why a hub template captures ~none; NC/Triangle specifics.
P4 Off-page synergy: does deep content amplify off-page ROI; what $500/mo realistically buys + 6-12mo impact; the $5k own-it + $500/mo vs $297/mo rent case.
P5 GHL platform SEO limits: PageSpeed cap, no SSR/edge, schema gaps, CMS ceiling, no programmatic gen, duplicate-URL traps — cited to GHL's OWN boards where possible; plus the honest balance.
P6 Map-pack honesty: GBP~32%+reviews drive the pack; the site wins organic+long-tail+storm and SUPPORTS the pack but does not win it with pages.
P7 Conversion architecture: map-pack call-button cut -> call leak; 74%-unanswered stat; speed-to-lead/instant-estimate/dual-intent close-rate data.
P8 AI search future-proofing: AI ~0.3% of lead VOLUME today; agentic booking grounds on the site (schema/pricing); sell future-proofing not a lead flood.
P9 Platform-tier scaling: what scaled/multi-office roofers actually run vs the GHL-template tier; the scaling-headroom case (don't name brands unverified).
P10 ROI math: ticket x close-rate band -> value-per-lead -> annual revenue + delta vs each GHL tier; conservative/realistic/optimistic; flag MODELED.
P11 Honesty guardrails: the consolidated what-NOT-to-claim list + FTC/defensibility posture.
checklist: Traffic multiple (deep vs thin) with conditions
Lead multiple (deep vs thin) with conditions
Thin-page downside (zero/negative) caveat
Location-page lift case studies, verified + de-vendored
Proximity ceiling on the pack for far suburbs
Doorway penalty line / real-job requirement
Post-storm search surge % corroborated beyond one vendor
Storm ticket size + close rate ranges
Off-page: links move organic > pack; $500/mo buys foundation+drip
GHL PageSpeed cap cited to measurable evidence
GHL schema/CMS/programmatic ceilings cited to GHL's own boards
GHL honest concessions (5-page local + CRM/conversion)
Map-pack: site supports but does not win the pack with pages
Call-button cut -> 20-40% call leak (provenance graded)
74% unanswered-calls provenance graded
Speed-to-lead close-rate data (5-min rule etc.)
AI ~0.3% lead volume double-confirmed; quality higher
Agentic booking grounds on schema/pricing (future-proofing)
Scaled roofers run custom/WP/enterprise not $297 templates (headroom case, no unverified brands)
ROI model inputs all sourced; outputs flagged modeled
Consolidated honesty / what-not-to-claim list
deliverables: KM_VALUEPROP_MASTER.md (one section per pillar, every claim cited inline)
KM_VALUEPROP_REELS_HOOKS.md (~10-15 hooks, each tied to a citation + honest framing)
